title: Sumpjaw deployed. Twelve new threats to review.

boards.pitch: A scissor-wing interceptor and an enormous wind manta. The most direct fit for a fast aerial battle.

mini.name: Windrazor
mini.identity: Twin needle noses, a royal-blue canopy and white hinged cutting wings around teal ramjets.
mini.parts: One complete aircraft body. Folding wings belong to consistent whole poses; gun mouths remain fixed to their real mounts.
attacks: Shear Run
Wings fold and pressure builds before a committed diagonal cutting pass. Dodge across the marked route; punish its recovery turn.
Needle Rake
The real wing guns fire three narrow wind-slug lanes with a clear opening. It banks into its firing direction.
Crosswind Return
Leaves one side, returns from the opposite side with a shadow and authored roll, then settles before firing again.
mini.frames: Idle, wings open/close, bite-like shear commitment, gun recoil, bank, drift, barrel roll, somersault, depth return, white hit and complete destruction.

boss.name: Stratosphere Leviathan
boss.identity: Broad white crescent wings, two huge pressure turbines and a central teal heart surrounded by four small gun pods.
boss.parts: Four gun pods, two complete turbine-wing assemblies and the central heart hull. Weapon loss removes the matching attacks; broken turbines leave visible wrecked mounts.
attacks: Pressure Valley
Turbines visibly spool up and send two broad currents around an open corridor. Their angle commits before release.
Feathering Guns
Pods recoil independently and alternate straight wind-slug rakes. Destroying a pod creates a lasting gap.
Broken Wing Turn
After turbine loss it banks unevenly, repositions and exposes its pressure heart during a longer recovery.
boss.frames: Separate turbine spool/recoil/ruin banks, intact central body, complete wing turns, heart charge/release and full-module explosions.

boards.pitch: A mechanical dragonfly and a three-turbine grapple engine. Very different silhouettes and attack rhythms.

mini.name: Draft Widow
mini.identity: Four lattice pressure wings, a narrow armored spine and six hooked legs around a blue optic cockpit.
mini.parts: A complete core fuselage plus paired left/right wing banks. Wing damage changes the bank and ambush choices without stretching the remaining body.
attacks: Hooked Cross
One side folds its wings and hooks its legs before a lateral strike. The opposite-side return gets its own tell.
Needle Thread
Hovers sideways and fires a brief aimed stream from its head guns, then changes height while recovering.
Wingbeat Slip
An authored roll and short depth feint precede a foreground dive. Its distant silhouette cannot damage the player.
mini.frames: Independent wingbeats, whole bank/roll/depth poses, hooked-leg windup/contact/recovery, fixed head nozzles, hits and wing break.

boss.name: Sky Anvil
boss.identity: A heavy anchor-shaped hull suspended between three enormous ducted turbines, twin cannons and a physical retracting claw.
boss.parts: Three turbine/outrigger modules, two independent cannon assemblies, a complete grapple and the center hull. The main body stays intact after mounts break.
attacks: Skyhook Drop
A ground Retina commits beneath the extended claw. The grapple slams that point, then slowly retracts into a punish window.
Triple Draft
Turbines spool in sequence, alternating pressure lanes. Only one heavy pressure sweep releases at a time.
Anvil Rake
The real twin cannons track, lock and recoil through short straight volleys while the grapple stays retracted.
boss.frames: Turbine spin and damage, cannon yaw/recoil, claw extension/impact/retraction, hull sway, depth turns and real assembly breakup.

boards.pitch: A flying scissor drone and a towering pressure-cannon array. The most unusual direction of the three.

mini.name: Cloud Guillotine
mini.identity: Two enormous opposing C-shaped blade airfoils hinge around a diamond pressure chamber with two fixed gun barrels.
mini.parts: Two complete blade/hinge modules and an intact center. Destroying one blade removes its cutting attack and changes the return turn.
attacks: Closing Sky
The two airfoils close into a compact wheel before a committed pass, then open into a broad shear during recovery.
Split Gust
The center barrels fire alternating slender wind crescents with a readable gap between the streams.
Crosscut
It opens both vanes, turns into the flight direction and sweeps one side. Its recovery exposes the center chamber.
mini.frames: Blade open/close, hinge movement, complete turn/roll banks, center recoil, charge glow, white hits and separate blade destruction.

boss.name: Tempest Choir
boss.identity: A tall pressure heart, white buoyancy pods and a fan of jointed trumpet-like compressor cannons.
boss.parts: Independent pressure cannons, rear pressure pods and the complete heart hull. The final module count will be locked from the selected design before frame production.
attacks: Breath by Breath
Alternate cannon banks compress and fire curved wind crescents in a deliberate rhythm. Broken mouths open permanent lanes.
Pressure Chord
Three selected bell mouths glow in order before releasing separated straight bursts. No simultaneous arena-filling release.
Last Lung
With pressure pods gone, the exposed heart expels one strong warned gust and needs a long recharge.
boss.frames: Complete cannon swivel/recoil, compressor vanes, bellows charge, pod damage, intact core aftermath and venting death.

boards.pitch: A new tri-crescent optic and a four-fan water crown. Recognizable roles, rebuilt as separate animatable machines.

mini.name: Eye of the Undertow
mini.identity: Three crescent blade-emitter assemblies around one white-cyan iris, with visible rotary joints.
mini.parts: Three independent blade/projector modules and a complete iris core. The eye remains sealed until its three outer projector modules are destroyed.
attacks: Threefold Sweep
The white iris charges; all surviving emitter arms rotate on one shared clock and sweep with a deliberately open arc.
Iris Lance
The core muzzle forms white energy before a fast committed beam. Its aperture visibly closes during recovery.
Broken Orbit
At half health it corkscrews offscreen and dashes back with separate side-projector bursts and a visible return warning.
mini.frames: Full360 body and individual joint headings, aperture open/close, core charge/muzzle, projector recoil, exact socket masks, ruined mounts and death fragments.

boss.name: Pelagic Crown
boss.identity: A crownlike swept hull, bright central reservoir, four separate fan-booms and four forward cannon modules.
boss.parts: Four cannons, four full fan/boom assemblies, reservoir and intact hull. Destroyed weapon modules stop emitting. A staged reservoir gate follows the chosen break order.
attacks: Crown Rain
Fans spin and launch water mortar grenades north; separate ground Retinas mark their return geysers.
Hydro Spread
Forward cannons face their warning lanes and alternate spread water slugs. Fans remain the grenade launchers.
Pressure Surge
The reservoir fills and shakes before three approaching water walls, with lane warnings and aqua wave sound.
boss.frames: Independent fan swirl, full cannon yaw/recoil, filling reservoir, northbound grenade launch, returning geysers, whole-module break and exposed hull.

boards.pitch: An opening spiral spacecraft and a reservoir-tower dreadnought. Strong phase changes through real mechanical anatomy.

mini.name: Abyssal Nautilus
mini.identity: A helicoidal armored shell, exposed gimbal beam arms and a white eye inside a complete central spindle.
mini.parts: Four curved shell sectors, two complete projector arms and an intact iris core. The shells physically open; destroying them removes those actual modules.
attacks: Shell Bloom
Sectors hinge open around the glowing iris before projector arms sweep two committed arcs.
Corkscrew Lance
One continuous rotation clock drives the shell, optic and beam headings; the firing cycle does not restart the spin.
Emergency Jet
A damaged shell vents aqua energy, retreats into depth and returns through a warned charge lane.
mini.frames: Whole turntable, complete opening/closing shell sectors, arm gimbal rotations, iris recoil/charge, corresponding collision masks and full broken-shell aftermath.

boss.name: Trench Cathedral
boss.identity: Three huge blue-glass pressure columns over a squat prow, four water cannons, two fan booms and a central floodgate.
boss.parts: Three complete reservoirs, four gun modules, two fan-booms, the floodgate and intact chassis. Reservoir loss drains matching weapons and opens the central gate in stages.
attacks: Pressure Cascade
Reservoirs fill in sequence before their cannons release separated heavy water salvos.
Floodgate
The central gate opens with a visible water-energy buildup and launches one broad surge. Its warning leaves side escape routes.
Geyser Battery
Fan-booms angle north and lob timed water mortars, then swing back into their resting sockets.
boss.frames: Water volume and swirl inside each reservoir, cannon recoil/yaw, fan rotations, gate opening, reduced-pressure phases and real module explosions.

boards.pitch: A folding four-vane laser spindle and a three-prow hydraulic hunter. The largest departure from the current silhouettes.

mini.name: Prism Wraith
mini.identity: A long diamond spindle, white square-gimbal iris and four spearhead prism vanes on individual elbows.
mini.parts: Four complete vane/elbow/projector assemblies and an intact spindle core. Breaking a vane removes its beam and changes the available sweep directions.
attacks: Prism Unfold
Vanes open into a cross while the inner light charges, then alternate beams across a warned open sector.
Diamond Drill
The whole machine folds tight and corkscrews through a committed dash; it must reopen before attacking again.
Wraith Orbit
The core hovers in depth while remaining vanes turn independently, then visibly returns to the foreground for its damage window.
mini.frames: Complete folded/unfolded silhouettes, elbow headings, shared-clock spinning, lens charge, individual projector fire and full-spindle aftermath.

boss.name: Riptide Hydra
boss.identity: Three long prow hulls linked by a hydraulic spine, two huge water fans, separate twin guns and rear pressure reservoirs.
boss.parts: Two complete side prows with fan assemblies, two separate twin-gun mounts, two reservoirs and an intact central heart hull. Each side's destruction disables its matching arsenal.
attacks: Hydra Mortars
Outer fans alternate high northbound water grenades; their landing marks commit before geyser impact.
Trident Rush
Side prows and main hull charge in a staggered sequence with clearly separated paths and real return turns.
Slipstream Flood
The remaining central reservoir fills, marks a water trail and accelerates into a warned forward surge.
boss.frames: Whole side-prow hinges, fan swirl, twin gun rotations/recoil, reservoir fill/drain, drift/roll/depth turns, destroyed sockets and complete central-hull death.
